prompts.half_body: Use case: stylized-concept character recasting. Create ONE revised SINGLE half-body character identity portrait on pure white, head through hips, no panels or text. Image 1 is the established older male lead in blue-gray, a COMPARISON ONLY: do not copy his face. Image 2 is Lu Xingzhou in burgundy, the EDIT TARGET: keep his burgundy outer robe, charcoal cross-collar inner garment, wrapped wrist cuffs, plain sash, left-hip sheathed sword and red tassel, adult 18-year-old age, slender athletic proportions, same semi-realistic Chinese guofeng rendering. Image 3 is an old video contact sheet, not a face reference; ignore it. Deliberately RECAST Lu's face so he is easily distinguishable from the older male lead even without color cues. Lu has a noticeably SHORTER, WIDER softly rounded face, full youthful cheeks, softly squared rounded chin (not narrow pointed V), larger round-open dark eyes, gently rising curved eyebrows rather than dense horizontal brows, short softly rounded nose and subtly fuller lips with a clear cupid's bow. No resemblance to the older male's long sharp face. Give Lu an asymmetrical side-swept fringe across part of forehead and a compact high ponytail tied with the existing modest silver band; keep no tall ornate crown, no long middle part. Clearly an adult young man, no child proportions, no feminized makeup, no scars or facial hair. Calm neutral expression, eyes to camera, relaxed arms, complete head and hips, sword remains sheathed at anatomical LEFT hip (viewer right). Soft neutral even light, white background, cloth texture and softly realistic skin consistent with original series, not glossy CGI or heavy line anime. Preserve wardrobe; change facial identity and fringe deliberately as specified. Output only revised Lu, never older lead, never side-by-side.
